rv.q: More irritating is the fidgety portrayal of the animals, the six-strong ensemble grunting and hoof-scraping through Ian Wooldridge's 1982 adaptation like an undergraduate actors' workshop.

cn.t: This adaptation of Orwell's classic earns mixed-to-positive reviews for its atmospheric staging and timely political resonance, though some critics find the execution uneven.
